comment: The upstream revision every corpus rule came from. `tools/import-cxx.py --all --pin tests/corpus/PIN.json --git-repo <llvm> --check` must reproduce the three .gisel files byte for byte. The commit is a plain upstream llvm-project commit: local patches in a worktree cannot change what was imported, so the corpus keeps the reviewed deviations below. `patches` lists the unmerged upstream PRs this repository carries; the official side of the A/B harness is built from a tree with them applied, which is why the corpus asks for the post-fix behaviour. When they land upstream, move `commit` past them and delete both the patches and the deviations.
